title: Reflexing
description: The primitive act of turning back upon itself: reflex(S) = relating(S, S), one instantaneous self-application (ontology.ttl `rel:Reflexing`). Reflexing is the ENGINE; Differentiating is its product. Distinguished from Reflecting, which holds the reflexive relation open across a sequence (R(0) := S, R(n+1) := reflex(R(n))) rather than applying it once.

subject.description: The S in reflex(S) = relating(S, S): the one term the act applies to itself, occupying both the subject-side and the object-side of the relating it produces.
